prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-10121
prose.body:
Hi Fallowfield Games team,

Hope your week is going well! This is just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-10121 for $6,591.60 USDC. 

To keep things moving smoothly on both ends, please direct the payment to our standard vendor wallet: 0x9933340853b48a3974646f7e96e1c5fd2984941d.

As always, please include the invoice number in the transfer memo so our accounting team can match the payment promptly. If you’ve already sent this out, feel free to disregard this message.

Let us know if you need a copy of the original invoice or any additional details. We appreciate your partnership!

Best regards,
Alder Legal Billing Team
